name: Assarain Group
meta: Assarain Group of Companies: 18 companies across retail, wholesale, manufacturing, construction and property in Oman.

hero.title: Eighteen companies, one group
hero.lede: From concrete and steel to food, furnishing, insurance and specialist clinics, Assarain Group has been operating in Oman since 1975.

about.title: Five decades of diversified growth
body: Assarain has operated since its inception in 1975. Its companies sit in four business groups: retail and consumer services, commercial wholesale, manufacturing, and construction, maintenance and property.

points.title: Joint ventures
points.text: Savills and Partners Oman, and Kone Assarain LLC.

points.title: Manufacturing base
points.text: Concrete products, modern steel mills, and plastic and acrylic industries.

points.title: Health & insurance
points.text: Hatat Specialty Clinics and Assarain Insurance Services are part of the group.

services.title: Our business groups
services.intro: Eighteen companies, organised into four business groups.
